headline: Executive order creates a new military medal, the Inherent Resolve Campaign Medal, for service in Operation Inherent Resolve.
what_it_does: This order creates a new military award called the Inherent Resolve Campaign Medal. Operation Inherent Resolve is the name of the U.S. military campaign against the group ISIS in Iraq and Syria. The medal recognizes service members who took part in that campaign. Detailed eligibility rules are not described in the material provided.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. military service members who served in Operation Inherent Resolve
who_it_affects.how: They may become eligible to receive the new campaign medal.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 30, 2016; the specific effective and eligibility dates are not provided in the source material.
